children.name: date
children.label: Date
children.help: Year (eg. 1624) or ISO date (yyyy-mm or yyyy-mm-dd). Use minus (-) for BCE dates (eg. -375 for 375 BCE)

children.name: time
children.label: Time
children.help: Optional: hh or hh:mm or hh:mm:ss
children.patternMessage: Enter the time as hh, hh:mm or hh:mm:ss

children.name: zone
children.label: Time zone
children.help: Optional, with a time: hours from UTC, + for east (Europe, Africa, Asia), - for west (N and S America)
children.patternMessage: Enter the time zone as +hh or -hh:mm

children.name: determination
children.label: Type of determination
children.help: How were the dates arrived at?

children.name: comment
children.label: Comment / original information
children.help: Stored with the date to record the original values entered
